description: Server RPM metadata, package inventory, plugin processes and queued package actions.

notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 11.32 and later; operates on server package management.

Changes rpm.versions data rather than installing or removing packages. Upstream strongly recommends running /usr/local/cpanel/scripts/check_cpanel_pkgs afterward; the client does not execute scripts, retry or roll back the change. Inspect the returned status flag independently of the API envelope.

notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 64 and later; operates on server package management.

Attempts to repair yum cache issues. The source documents cache_seems_ok_now as literal 1, returned only on success; the current generated validator accepts native integers and does not enforce that single-value enum. Failure returns metadata only and remains an API failure. A repair changes server cache state, with no client retry or rollback.

notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 11.52 and later; operates on server package management.

Supply exactly one selector family: namespaces or packages, each as one string or a nonempty sequential string list encoded with repeated ns or package keys. The source marks both required but explicitly makes them alternatives; the client does not infer cross-field validation. Namespace prose permits ea and values returned by ea4_get_additional_pkg_prefixes, including the altea example, while the formal enum lists only ea. This discrepancy remains unresolved. Omitted disableExcludes preserves the default 0; explicit false sends 0. more_info_url may be null; omitted fields remain omitted.

evidence.note: Pinned whm.openapi.json.gz SHA-256 6edb13c51d53f3c2be1fa83cc93e31d3a81f4f8506b3b45284fa00b986041594. /package_manager_get_package_info GET declares x-readonly=true. Use GET for this read.

Pinned whm.openapi.json.gz SHA-256 6edb13c51d53f3c2be1fa83cc93e31d3a81f4f8506b3b45284fa00b986041594. /package_manager_get_package_info description requires either ns or package, and each parameter forbids the other. Despite both formal required:true flags, make each individually optional so either documented selector family is callable; callers must provide exactly one family. Both parameter descriptions explicitly repeat the same wire key for multiple values. ns formal enum [ea] contradicts prose permitting prefixes returned by ea4_get_additional_pkg_prefixes, with altea as the repeated example. Suppress only the closed enum PHPDoc, preserving string input and the documented discrepancy.

notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 11.52 and later; operates on server package management.

Determines prospective install, uninstall, upgrade and unaffected package lists without submitting them. packages is required; namespaces is optional. Both accept a string or nonempty sequential string list and repeat their exact wire keys. Namespace prose permits additional discovered prefixes such as altea despite the formal ea-only enum. Inspect all returned lists; planning is not installation or completion.

Namespace prose permits ea and additional prefixes from ea4_get_additional_pkg_prefixes and gives ns=altea, while its formal enum contains only ea. Suppress only the closed enum PHPDoc; retain string input and required package selection.

notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 11.52 and later; operates on server package management.

Queues package installation, removal and upgrades as background tasks. Each action family is optional; omit it for no action of that kind, or pass one string or a nonempty sequential string list with repeated identical keys. The returned build is a process ID; API success does not establish completion. The client does not poll, retry or roll back package changes.
